artworks.title: Piazza San Marco
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with scratching on wove paper

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with a Hollow
artworks.medium: brush drawing in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a mountain landscape seen from a slightly elevated point. The horizon line is high, with mountain peaks dominating the background. The painting features detailed brushstrokes depicting the terrain and vegetation. The scene is in a monochromatic sepia tone, giving it a warm and vintage aesthetic. In the foreground, there are dense shrubs and bushes, leading to fields and wooded areas toward the foothills. The sky above has soft clouds blending into the landscape.

artworks.title: An Elderly Woman in a Striped Shawl
artworks.medium: pastel and watercolor on two joined sheets of blue paper, mounted on white paper and on original strainer
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in a shoulder-length portrait. She is positioned facing the viewer with a subtle tilt of her head to the right. Her facial features include aged, wrinkled skin with a fair complexion, deeply set eyes, and defined cheekbones. Her hair is mostly covered by a cloth, but it appears greyish in color, peeking out slightly from under a plaid headscarf that is draped over her head and shoulders. The scarf is primarily tan with blue and grey stripes. Her clothing is partially visible, revealing a textured garment with a fur-like appearance. She wears a pearl earring in her left ear. The background is a simple, muted green tone.

artworks.title: A Lake in the Tyrol (Un lac du Tyrol)
artworks.medium: etching in red-brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a large tree dominating the left side, a figure in a boat on the right, a calm body of water, and a distant landform on the horizon. The artwork features expressive brushstrokes, a mono-tonal sepia color palette, and a dynamic play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Studies of Legs and Drapery [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped fabric and limbs. It features textured fabric and the anatomical elements of legs and arms, depicted with lines and tonal shades. The focus is on the dynamic flow and folds of the clothing, rendered in a reddish-orange hue to accentuate volume and movement. The lower limbs and feet are visible, drawn with anatomical accuracy showcasing muscular structure and foot positioning. The drawing suggests movement based on the placement and orientation of the fabric and limbs.

artworks.title: Studies of Hands and Bending Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white
artworks.description: The image comprises multiple studies focusing on figures, with segments highlighting parts such as torsos, limbs, and pieces of clothing. One figure is seated, facing diagonally with hands held up in front, palms open. The facial features are simplified, with defined lines marking the hair. The figure is draped in flowing garments, indicated by sweeping lines and folds. Around the figures are studies of hands and cloth as individual elements. The drawing is on a light-toned background, creating a contrast with the reddish color and white highlights used for dimension and detail.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man at the Golden Gate
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around columns. The figures are engaged in an action or conversation. The composition is balanced between the columns. The use of hatching and line work suggests depth and contrast. The columns provide a structural element that divides the piece into sections. Each figure is clad in flowing garments. The interactions and gestures imply a narrative moment captured within this architectural setting.

artworks.title: Urania
artworks.medium: gray and brown chalk with pen and brown ink (the head, the undergarment, and the right hand are traced with pen and black ink)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a turned position, with an updo and a headscarf. She wears a robe and drop earrings, with her hands resting in her lap. In the background, there are swirling patterns.

artworks.title: The Revenge of the Sorcerer Virgil
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate): 7.5 × 4.4 cm (2 15/16 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure holding a staff. The scene is detailed, with the figure sitting on a structure. Another figure in the foreground is holding a cylindrical object. The background is filled with various elements and figures, adding depth to the image. The figures are depicted with fine lines and hatching for texture and shadows.

artworks.title: Trees Reflected in a Brook
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 21.7 x 24.7 cm (8 9/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
overall (mount): 31.3 x 34.6 cm (12 5/16 x 13 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene viewed from the water's edge, showing a horizon of trees with branches leaning into the water. A figure is near the water, reaching into it. The artwork is in brown ink on cream paper, with detailed brushstrokes conveying movement and texture. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with varying shades of brown emphasizing natural forms and textures.

artworks.title: Aeneas Saving His Father from Troy
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in tan and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. The central figure is carrying two smaller figures on their shoulder. They seem to be in motion, with a chaotic and fiery background. The figures display distress and vulnerability. The drawing features intricate linework and depicts a cityscape with smoke and flames on the left and vegetation on the right.

artworks.title: La Confidence
artworks.artist: Jacques-Firmin Beauvarlet after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 48.6 x 36.8 cm (19 1/8 x 14 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women engaged in a seated position. The woman on the right is seated on what appears to be a cushioned bench, holding a thread and a small object in her hands, while the other woman kneels beside her, gesturing with her hands. The woman on the left has her head turned towards the seated woman, with her hair covered by a scarf or shawl. The seated woman has her head slightly inclined, with her hair tucked under a cap or headdress that is adorned. Both women are dressed in flowing, ornate garments with intricate patterns and detailed embroidery. The sitting woman wears a decorative necklace, and the surface they are on displays woven or knit materials. Behind them, a large piece of elaborately patterned drapery hangs, next to a window showing a faint landscape with a soft sky and trees.

artworks.title: Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman and Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brownish-gray wash over black chalk, some red chalk at the lower left and at bottom center, touches of heightening with white, vertical fold through the center, incised for transfer

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of two individuals and a child. One person is a seated woman holding an infant standing in her lap. The woman has detailed facial features, long hair, and is wearing a long, flowing garment. The other person, a man, is seated beside her, reading a large open book. He has a beard and styled hair, wearing a draped robe. In the background, there is an open curtain showing a landscape with hills and trees.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 51.5 x 33.7 cm (20 1/4 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts women with a baby near water, surrounded by trees. The setting is idyllic and pastoral, with several women gathered around the baby in a small body of water. One woman is tending to the baby, possibly retrieving it from the water, while another woman stands with a parasol. The figures wear flowing garments typical of classical or historical attire. Tall trees and lush foliage frame the scene. The edges of the drawing feature decorative scrollwork and floral motifs.

artworks.title: David and Abigail
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52 x 34 cm (20 1/2 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling on the ground, offering food with a plate in her hands. She has a calm facial expression, with her hair neatly arranged and secured with a headscarf. The woman is dressed in flowing clothing. Surrounding her on the ground are several loaves of bread, a tall jug, and a basket filled with food. Next to her, four standing men are engaged with her. One of the men is reaching out a hand towards the woman, while the others appear to be conversing amongst themselves. Behind them, a donkey with packed sacks is visible. The backdrop includes trees with detailed foliage. Decorative flourishes frame the image.

artworks.title: Rebecca at the Well
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 51.7 x 33.8 cm (20 3/8 x 13 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a well, a man standing next to her holding an object, and a third person partially visible on the left. The woman is facing slightly left with her head tilted downward. She wears a flowing dress, and her hair is styled back. The man has his face covered by a hat or hood and wears loose, layered clothing with a cloak over his shoulder. The third person's upper body is visible, peering over the well. Sheep and other animals are nearby, and the background features tall trees and a serene landscape with ornate borders framing the scene.

artworks.title: Moses Striking a Shepherd
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 51.7 x 34 cm (20 3/8 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in different body positions. In the foreground, a man lies on the ground with his torso exposed and covered by a draped cloth. Another man stands above him, leaning forward with one arm raised, holding a stick. To the left, another figure is partially visible holding onto a tree branch. In the background to the right, a woman stands near a well holding a large jug. Behind her, a seated figure tends to a sheep. The setting includes rocky structures and sparse trees, with mountains in the distance. Floral and scroll patterns frame the scene as decorative elements.

artworks.title: Abraham Kneeling before the Three Angels
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 51.6 x 33.6 cm (20 5/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of divine messengers appearing in a rustic setting. The scene features several angelic figures interacting with a person kneeling before them. Elements such as trees, a rural house, flowing garments, and delicate lines create a sense of movement and ethereality. Fine details like the texture of leaves and architectural features add depth. The border of the image is embellished with ornate flourishes.

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52 x 33.8 cm (20 1/2 x 13 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of a drawing featuring angels surrounding a sleeping figure. The central figure is reclining against a tree, with one angel on a ladder reaching towards the sky. The scene includes clouds and trees, and the artwork has an ornate border and delicate detailing.

artworks.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52.7 x 34.3 cm (20 3/4 x 13 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure and a shepherd in a pastoral scene. An angel with wings and flowing robes appears to speak or gesture to a kneeling shepherd, tending to his flock at the center of the image. Trees and foliage fill the background. A shepherd’s staff is on the ground next to the shepherd, with sheep nearby. The drawing shows detailed textures in the wings, clothing, and natural elements, contributing to a classical and harmonious composition.

artworks.title: Jephthah and His Daughter
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52.5 x 34.3 cm (20 11/16 x 13 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures in classical clothing amidst architectural ruins and natural surroundings. The drawing shows figures surrounded by foliage and ancient ruins, with a stone archway to the right. The scene is detailed, with fine lines capturing texture. The figures display dynamic gestures, and decorative elements like ornate scrollwork border the scene. The overall tone is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Abraham Dismissing Hagar
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52.5 x 34.2 cm (20 11/16 x 13 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures positioned outdoors. The first person on the left is standing with their body turned to the side, gesturing with one hand. The second person, a woman, is standing beside a child, turned slightly to one side. The child has short hair and is wearing a tunic and cap with a contemplative expression. The background consists of a rustic setting with old stone ruins, a large tree, and a partially visible woman leaning out of a window behind the central figures. The scene has a detailed ornamental border that frames the composition.

artworks.title: Joseph and His Brothers
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 52.4 x 34.3 cm (20 5/8 x 13 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving showing three full-length figures standing in the foreground, with one kneeling figure to their right. The standing figures are wearing robes; the one on the left wears a turban, and the one in the middle has wavy hair and a beard. The third standing figure has longer hair and looks towards the kneeling person, who is engaged in working or interacting with the ground. All figures are barefoot, and the clothing appears to be flowing and layered. One of the standing figures holds a shepherd’s crook or staff. In the background, there is a pastoral scene with trees and distant figures and animals. The engraving is framed with decorative elements and Italian text is inscribed below the figures.
